hero.title: How can we help?
hero.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or reach out to us directly — we usually reply within 24 hours.

items.question: What breathing patterns does Toona support?
items.answer: Toona includes Box breathing (4-4-4-4), 4-7-8 for sleep, Resonance (5-0-5), and a fully custom mode where you can set the exact duration for each phase (inhale, hold, exhale).

items.question: How do I create a custom pattern?
items.answer: Open the App, tap the settings icon. Under 'Breathing Phases', use the sliders to adjust the duration. Your custom pattern is saved automatically.

items.question: What is the CO₂ Tolerance Test?
items.answer: The CO₂ test measures how long you can comfortably hold your breath after a normal exhale. It's a simple way to track your breathing health. A higher score generally indicates better breathing control and efficiency.

items.question: Is my data stored privately?
items.answer: Yes. All training data is stored locally on your device. Toona does not collect or transmit any personal health data to servers. See our Privacy Policy for details.

items.question: Does Toona support Apple Watch?
items.answer: Apple Watch support is planned for future releases. Check the Dev Log for the latest updates.

items.question: Is there an Android version of Toona?
items.answer: Currently Toona is iOS only. An Android version is planned, keep an eye on the Dev Log for release announcements.

items.question: What are ambient sounds?
items.answer: Ambient sounds are background audio (white noise, wind, rain, etc.) played during breathing training. They help block out distractions and create a calm training environment.
